stemMd: Which word most precisely completes the sentence? "After finding that the totals did not match the receipts, the treasurer ___ the accounts to locate the error."
explanationMd: A mismatch calls for careful inspection of the existing records. "Examined" precisely names that investigative action.

distractorRationale.a: Predicting accounts does not mean checking existing records.
distractorRationale.c: Moving records does not identify an error.
distractorRationale.b: Decoration does not investigate a numerical mismatch.
